annotations.title: Load for a target reps and RPE

description: Find the load for a set of a given number of reps at a target RPE, from a known or estimated one-rep max. Rounded to the nearest 0.5.

formula.description: One-rep max formula: epley (weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30), the one the IronLedger app uses) or brzycki (weight × 36 ÷ (37 − reps)).

rpe.description: Rating of perceived exertion, 5 to 10, read as reps in reserve (RPE 8 = 2 reps left). Half points allowed.

unit.description: Weight unit for every load in and out: kg or lb.

name: rpe_target_load
